#
# The GDExtension: one shared library named like godot-cpp's own builds
# (`libskydot.linux.template_debug.x86_64.so`), so game/skydot.gdextension can
# list every platform and configuration.
# world.fb, script, LOD and animation readers, generated by flatc straight from
# the shared schemas in formats/schema/, so both halves read one definition.
set(SKYDOT_FB_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
# The vocabulary both halves share (formats/include/README.md).
set(SKYDOT_FORMATS_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../formats/include")
set(SKYDOT_WORLD_HEADER "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}/world_generated.h")
set(SKYDOT_SCRIPT_HEADER "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}/script_generated.h")
set(SKYDOT_LOD_HEADER "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}/lod_generated.h")
set(SKYDOT_ANIMATION_HEADER "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}/animation_generated.h")
foreach(schema IN ITEMS world script lod animation)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}/${schema}_generated.h"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}"
        COMMAND flatc --cpp --cpp-std c++17 --scoped-enums -o "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../formats/schema/${schema}.fbs"
        DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../formats/schema/${schema}.fbs" flatc
        COMMENT "flatc: ${schema}.fbs -> ${schema}_generated.h"
        VERBATIM)
endforeach()

# One target runs flatc: the extension and skydot_core both read the headers,
# and a rule listed in two targets can run twice at once.
add_custom_target(skydot_flatbuffers DEPENDS
    "${SKYDOT_WORLD_HEADER}"
    "${SKYDOT_SCRIPT_HEADER}"
    "${SKYDOT_LOD_HEADER}"
    "${SKYDOT_ANIMATION_HEADER}")

# The sources that do not touch Godot: the Papyrus VM and its saves, AI
# packages, actor plans, virtual paths and file mappings. Nothing in them may include a
# godot-cpp header: that would stop the unit tests building.
set(SKYDOT_CORE_SOURCES
    src/assets/mapped_file.cpp
    src/assets/mapped_file.hpp
    src/assets/vpath.hpp
    src/vm/save.cpp
    src/vm/script_class.cpp
    src/vm/script_class.hpp
    src/vm/value.hpp
    src/vm/vm.cpp
    src/vm/vm.hpp
    src/world/actors.cpp
    src/world/actors.hpp
    src/world/packages.cpp
    src/world/packages.hpp)

# Both copies read the same headers and need flatc's output first.
function(skydot_core_library name)
    add_library(${name} STATIC ${SKYDOT_CORE_SOURCES})
    add_dependencies(${name} skydot_flatbuffers)
    target_include_directories(${name} PUBLIC src "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}" "${SKYDOT_FORMATS_DIR}")
    target_include_directories(${name} SYSTEM PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/extern/flatbuffers/include")
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE skydot::warnings)
endfunction()

# skydot_core goes into the extension, so it is compiled like it: the flags
# godot-cpp passes on (-fno-gnu-unique for hot reload; _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0 on
# MSVC), but not its include path.
skydot_core_library(skydot_core)
target_compile_options(skydot_core PRIVATE
    "$<TARGET_PROPERTY:godot-cpp,INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS>")
target_compile_definitions(skydot_core PRIVATE
    "$<TARGET_PROPERTY:godot-cpp,INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>")
set_target_properties(skydot_core PROPERTIES
    CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# The unit tests (tests/unit) link their own copy of the same sources, built
# like the tests: without godot-cpp's flags. On MSVC those turn exceptions off
# (_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0; GCC and clang keep -fno-exceptions to godot-cpp itself),
# but Catch2 and the tests need them on, and one binary must not mix the two:
# the STL's inline functions differ with the setting, so the linker would keep
# one of two incompatible definitions. Compiling six files twice costs less
# than that.
if(SKYDOT_BUILD_TESTS)
    skydot_core_library(skydot_core_testable)
endif()

add_library(skydot SHARED)

target_sources(skydot PRIVATE
    src/register_types.cpp
    src/register_types.hpp
    src/assets/asset_cache.cpp
    src/assets/asset_cache.hpp
    src/assets/model.cpp
    src/assets/model.hpp
    src/assets/pack.cpp
    src/assets/pack.hpp
    src/assets/pack_store.cpp
    src/assets/pack_store.hpp
    src/world/actor.cpp
    src/world/actor_placement.cpp
    src/world/actor_placement.hpp
    src/world/actor.hpp
    src/world/actor_animation.cpp
    src/world/ai.cpp
    src/world/ai.hpp
    src/world/actor_animation.hpp
    src/world/animator.cpp
    src/world/locomotion.cpp
    src/world/locomotion.hpp
    src/world/animator.hpp
    src/world/billboard.cpp
    src/world/billboard.hpp
    src/world/collision.cpp
    src/world/navmesh.cpp
    src/world/weather.cpp
    src/world/collision.hpp
    src/world/effect_asset.cpp
    src/world/effect_asset.hpp
    src/world/flicker.cpp
    src/world/grass.cpp
    src/world/image_space.cpp
    src/world/flicker.hpp
    src/world/water.cpp
    src/world/water.hpp
    src/world/terrain.cpp
    src/world/terrain.hpp
    src/world/materials.cpp
    src/world/materials.hpp
    src/world/particles.cpp
    src/world/particles.hpp
    src/world/player.cpp
    src/world/player.hpp
    src/vm/papyrus.cpp
    src/vm/papyrus.hpp
    src/vm/quests.cpp
    src/world/world.cpp
    src/world/world_data.cpp
    src/world/world_data.hpp
    src/world/refs.cpp
    src/world/lod.cpp
    src/world/lod.hpp
    src/world/quests.cpp
    src/world/world.hpp)
add_dependencies(skydot skydot_flatbuffers)

target_include_directories(skydot PRIVATE src "${SKYDOT_FB_DIR}")
target_include_directories(skydot SYSTEM PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/extern/flatbuffers/include")
target_link_libraries(skydot PRIVATE skydot_core godot::cpp skydot::warnings)

get_target_property(_godotcpp_suffix godot-cpp GODOTCPP_SUFFIX)

# Output goes straight to game/bin/, where the .gdextension file looks, so with
# `reloadable = true` a rebuild reloads in the running editor. No install step.
set(_output_dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/game/bin")

set_target_properties(skydot PROPERTIES
    CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN ON
    LINK_SEARCH_START_STATIC ON
    LINK_SEARCH_END_STATIC ON
    # Stops multi-config generators (MSVC) from adding a per-config
    # subdirectory.
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "$<1:${_output_dir}>"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "$<1:${_output_dir}>"
    PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "$<1:${_output_dir}>"
    PREFIX "lib"
    OUTPUT_NAME "skydot${_godotcpp_suffix}")
